translations.web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
translations.bsb: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
translations.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
translations.asv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
